_meta.title: Pedagogical Audit Rules
_meta.description: Rules used by the Pedagogical Agent to audit a generated planning. Each rule has a weight (contribution to the final score) and a severity (impact if violated).

workload._description: Maximum cognitive and time load per day and per week — ISO 21001 §8.3 (learner-centred approach)

breaks._description: Mandatory rest periods — ISO 21001 §8.3 + ISO 29993 §6.2 (learner wellbeing)

progression._description: Logical content sequencing — ISO 29993 §6.3 (learning design), ISO 21001 §8.2

practice_balance._description: Theory / Practice balance — ISO 29993 §6.3.3 (learning activities diversity)

teacher_workload._description: Trainer load limits — ISO 21001 §7.1.2 (competent persons), ISO 29993 §5.2

room._description: Room suitability for session type — ISO 21001 §7.1.3 (infrastructure)

difficulty_spread._description: Avoid clustering difficult content — ISO 21001 §8.3 (inclusive education)
